signal: Arize AI raised a $70M Series C in Feb 2025 at a $1B+ valuation and partnered with Microsoft in Nov 2025 to scale enterprise AI observability

email.body1:
Matt, saw Arize close the $70M Series C and partner with Microsoft to scale AI observability into the enterprise.

Momentum like that usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that gap is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Arize off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matt, quick follow-up for Arize.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most revenue leaders don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Arize needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matt, last bit of proof for Arize.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Arize's reply rate likely compares to peer AI-infra startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matt, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Standing up an enterprise motion after a raise is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Arize's motion? I'll tailor it to you either way.
